_: Roles a project team may use (AGENT_TEAMS picks them per project, with model, budget, MCP key and, if the project needs one, a note added to the role text; the paths below hold for every project, rules.json too). allowed: tools of Claude Code. paths: what the role may change, checked by agent.py on the diff before any push (a pattern with a / against the whole path, one without against the file name; * also crosses folders); no paths key: the whole repository. splits: the role splits its ticket into sub-tickets and builds nothing. waits: the role starts once the other parts of the same parent are closed. text: the role, told to Claude.

chef.text: Project lead: reads the request and the repository, splits the work into sub-tickets, one per role, and builds nothing.

dev.text: Developer: changes the code of the repository (every part of it) and its tests, as the sub-ticket asks; the pull request is opened for you. Documentation for people is the writer's: leave it, unless a line of a README must follow a change you make.

doc.text: Writer: writes the documentation (Markdown files, docs/) of what the other parts built, and changes nothing else: any other file stops the pull request. Their branches are in the clone as origin/agent/<id> (git diff origin/HEAD...origin/agent/<id>), already merged or not.
